title: A config change took down every region at once
intro: At 16:20 the edge proxies in all four regions started rejecting every request with 400 errors. No code was deployed. The rate-limit config repo, which Argo CD syncs to every region's cluster automatically, received a commit at 16:19.

steps.prompt: Confirm what changed: show the last commit in the edge-config repo with its diff.
steps.fake_output:
commit 7d3e9a1 (HEAD -> main)
Author: carol
Date:   16:19:02
    ratelimit: tighten per-IP limit
-    requests_per_unit: 100
-    unit: second
+    requests_per_unit: 100
+    unit: seconds
steps.hint: git show HEAD, or git log -1 -p

steps.prompt: 'seconds' isn't a valid unit, so the rate limiter rejects every request. Revert commit 7d3e9a1 so Argo CD syncs the good config everywhere.
steps.fake_output:
[main 2b8f4c6] Revert "ratelimit: tighten per-IP limit"
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)
To git.example.com:platform/edge-config.git
   7d3e9a1..2b8f4c6  main -> main

steps.prompt: Don't wait for the 3-minute polling interval: force a sync of the application edge-config in Argo CD.
steps.fake_output:
Name:               edge-config
Sync Status:        Synced to main (2b8f4c6)
Health Status:      Healthy

steps.prompt: Check how the apps for each region are set up: list the Argo CD apps with their sync policy.
steps.fake_output:
NAME                 CLUSTER     STATUS  HEALTH   SYNCPOLICY  REPO
edge-config-us-east  us-east     Synced  Healthy  Auto        edge-config.git (main)
edge-config-us-west  us-west     Synced  Healthy  Auto        edge-config.git (main)
edge-config-eu       eu          Synced  Healthy  Auto        edge-config.git (main)
edge-config-ap       ap          Synced  Healthy  Auto        edge-config.git (main)

steps.prompt: All four regions auto-sync the same branch the moment it changes: one bad commit hits everything at once. Validate the config before merge in the future: run the proxy's own config checker on ratelimit.yaml.
steps.fake_output:
error initializing configuration 'ratelimit.yaml': Protobuf message (type envoy.extensions.common.ratelimit.v3.RateLimitDescriptor) has unknown fields
[validation failed]
steps.hint: Many proxies and servers can validate a config without starting (nginx -t, envoy --mode validate).

resolution: This is one of the most common causes of large outages at big companies. Global configuration changes are riskier than code deploys, because they often skip the safety steps code goes through: canaries, staged regions, automated validation. The one-word typo was valid YAML but invalid config, the pipeline didn't validate it with the real parser, and GitOps auto-sync pushed it to all regions within a minute. The revert was fast because config lived in Git; that part went well. Durable fixes: validate configs in CI with the consuming software itself (envoy --mode validate, nginx -t, promtool check); roll config out by region, one region first (ideally the smallest) with a soak period and automated health checks before the next, the way code canaries work (sre-tutorial-002); and have the proxy reject a bad config and keep serving the last good one, instead of applying it. Treat configuration as code, including its rollout.
